description: Details for one business ShoreGrade lists, by its ShoreGrade page URL (https://shoregrade.ca/b/<slug>/) or its slug. Use it to compare businesses on what their Google reviewers praise: review_praise lists the praise labels the business page publishes, with the number of reviews behind each and the period read. review_praise_status "not_published" means ShoreGrade has not published praise for it, not that reviewers dislike it. ShoreGrade is a directory of local businesses that shows each business's Google rating and review count, and positive review recognition (Most loved, Well regarded) where recent reviews support it.

business.description: A ShoreGrade page URL or slug, as returned by find_local_business.
